reviews.review:
Meh... It's a horde shooter... set in the Alien franchise... essentially Alien Swarm but waaaay worse.
There are 3 types of enemies: paperweights, bullet sponges and extreme bullet sponges. 
To say the least, this game is not lore-accurate and the bland story does not do justice to the IP.
Misson objectives usually involve entering a new area, defending against a horde, then moving to the next room, defending against another horde to then proceed to the next room and fending off yet another horde etc. - very linear level design. 
Enemies spawn in droves, move along predefined paths and lack animations to organically move over obstacles.
Classes play very similarly, except for what guns you can bring: Small arms are essentially irrelevant, while heavy weapons, like the smartgun, are comically overpowered. Every class, no matter the equipped weapon, can roll around like it's Fortnite; every class brings the 'motion tracker' which works perfectly reliable, doesn't require an equipment slot and only highlights enemies (more formidable foes even get a colored dot). There is very little strategy and barely any way to communicate with your fellow marines. Instead, you are ALWAYS told via command coms where the next group of enemies is coming from. Sheesh!
There are some positives: The levels LOOK beautiful. The upgrade and challenge systems are enticing. It can also be fun to play together with 2 friends. Yes, a 'fireteam' consists of 3 marines - not 5 or 4, just 3 dudes.

tldr; honestly, if you're not fond of co-op horde shooters, you can safely skip this one. Play Alien Swarm or Aliens: Dark Descent instead.
